name: Matrix
description: Talk to her in Element or any Matrix app through her own Matrix account.
author: The Sara team

settings.label: Her Matrix ID
settings.tip: Her own account, like @sara-frank:matrix.org. Make a separate account for her, not your own.

settings.label: Her homeserver
settings.tip: The server her account lives on. Sara finds it from her Matrix ID; change it only if your server uses a different address for apps.

settings.label: My homeserver runs on my network
settings.tip: Turn on if her account is on a Matrix server in your home or on your Tailscale network, not on the internet. Then type its address with the port, like 192.168.1.20:8008.

settings.label: Access token
settings.tip: Her login key, made when you pressed Log her in (her password isn't kept). Kept encrypted in Sara's vault.

settings.label: Show typing
settings.tip: Shows '<her name> is typing…' in your room while she works. Only in your room with her.

settings.label: Send read receipts
settings.tip: Shows that she has read your message. Only in your room with her.

settings.label: Send reminders and messages she starts to my Matrix room too
settings.tip: Her reminders also come to your room with her. Never to other rooms.

es.Talk to her in Element or any Matrix app: Habla con ella en Element o cualquier app de Matrix a través de su propia cuenta de Matrix.
es.Her own account, like @sara-frank:matrix: Su propia cuenta, como @sara-frank:matrix.org. Crea una cuenta aparte para ella, no la tuya.
es.The server her account lives on. Sara fi: El servidor donde está su cuenta. Sara lo encuentra a partir de su ID de Matrix; cámbialo solo si tu servidor usa otra dirección para las apps.
es.My homeserver runs on my network: Mi servidor está en mi red
es.Turn on if her account is on a Matrix se: Actívalo si su cuenta está en un servidor de Matrix en tu casa o en tu red de Tailscale, no en internet. Luego escribe su dirección con el puerto, como 192.168.1.20:8008.
es.Her login key, made when you pressed Log: Su clave de acceso, creada al pulsar Iniciar su sesión (su contraseña no se guarda). Se guarda cifrada en la bóveda de Sara.
es.Shows '<her name> is typing…' in your ro: Muestra '<su nombre> está escribiendo…' en tu sala mientras trabaja. Solo en tu sala con ella.
es.Shows that she has read your message. On: Muestra que ha leído tu mensaje. Solo en tu sala con ella.
es.Send reminders and messages she starts t: Enviar también a mi sala de Matrix los recordatorios y mensajes que ella inicia
es.Her reminders also come to your room wit: Sus recordatorios también llegan a tu sala con ella. Nunca a otras salas.
